name: gnome-window-management
title: GNOME Window Management
description: Raycast-style window management commands for GNOME
author: mariano

commands.name: window-management
commands.title: Window Management
commands.description: Browse every available window layout and action

commands.name: hide-others
commands.title: Hide Other Applications
commands.description: Minimize every app except the focused app

commands.name: show-all
commands.title: Show Hidden Applications
commands.description: Restore applications hidden by Hide Other Applications

commands.name: center
commands.title: Center
commands.description: Center the focused window while preserving its size

commands.name: reasonable-size
commands.title: Reasonable Size
commands.description: Resize and center the focused window to a comfortable size

commands.name: almost-maximize
commands.title: Almost Maximize
commands.description: Fill ninety percent of the usable display and center the window

commands.name: maximize
commands.title: Maximize
commands.description: Maximize the focused window

commands.name: maximize-height
commands.title: Maximize Height
commands.description: Fill the usable display height

commands.name: maximize-width
commands.title: Maximize Width
commands.description: Fill the usable display width

commands.name: restore
commands.title: Restore
commands.description: Return the focused window to its previous geometry

commands.name: left-half
commands.title: Left Half
commands.description: Place the focused window in the left half

commands.name: right-half
commands.title: Right Half
commands.description: Place the focused window in the right half

commands.name: top-half
commands.title: Top Half
commands.description: Place the focused window in the top half

commands.name: bottom-half
commands.title: Bottom Half
commands.description: Place the focused window in the bottom half

commands.name: center-half
commands.title: Center Half
commands.description: Place the focused window in the center half

commands.name: top-left-quarter
commands.title: Top Left Quarter
commands.description: Place the focused window in the top-left quarter

commands.name: top-right-quarter
commands.title: Top Right Quarter
commands.description: Place the focused window in the top-right quarter

commands.name: bottom-left-quarter
commands.title: Bottom Left Quarter
commands.description: Place the focused window in the bottom-left quarter

commands.name: bottom-right-quarter
commands.title: Bottom Right Quarter
commands.description: Place the focused window in the bottom-right quarter

commands.name: previous-display
commands.title: Move to Previous Display
commands.description: Move the focused window to the previous display

commands.name: next-display
commands.title: Move to Next Display
commands.description: Move the focused window to the next display
